items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: And they mentioned Chilly Jim of Waco. I think he plays piano much.

ctx.x: The Flores in Houston. No, that was before I came. And the Benedict Donk on Matamara Street. Oh, this is way before I came. Yeah, I see.
And they mentioned Chilly Jim of Waco. I think he plays piano much. I think that's another one. Yeah.
Clem Nurse, did you know him? No. Big Boi Whopper on Cherokee Church.
